summary: Iteration 6 (Data Migration Wizard) tested end-to-end. Backend: 8/8 pytest cases pass covering schemas, analyze (Arabic CSV with AI mapping, .txt reject, unknown entity), and import (products with auto-barcode + auto-category, missing required field 400 with Arabic message, customers, suppliers). Frontend: full 4-step wizard flow via Playwright — nav item visible, 3 entity tiles, CSV upload, LLM-backed analyze returns mapping ('اسم الصنف'→name, 'سعر البيع'→sale_price), import completes and success card shows counters. Required-missing validation properly disables 'بدء الاستيراد' button.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is >1400 lines — should be modularized (routers/, services/) for maintainability.
/migration/import accepts mapping as a query-string parameter which limits URL length; consider moving to multipart form field for robustness with very large mapping dicts.
Bulk insert loop uses one insert_one per row — could use insert_many for perf on large files.

_ai_map_columns falls back to heuristic silently on any LLM failure (good), but there is no telemetry/flag indicating whether AI or heuristic produced the mapping — surface this to UI for transparency.
test_credentials: admin@pos.com / Admin@1234 (super); shop-owner test accounts auto-created per run with TEST_it6_/TEST_ui6_ prefixes.
seed_data_creation: Test shop + owner created via /api/admin/shops for each run; products/customers/suppliers imported via wizard.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Migration endpoints require shop-user (require_shop_user), not super_admin. Create a shop via /api/admin/shops then login as owner. LLM analyze can take 2-5s; heuristic fallback covers Arabic column names correctly for the standard header set used in tests.
